definition: Analytical KSISU geography
formula: Source geography after configured Ballari/Vijayanagara merge

definition: SCI: weighted share of openings covered
formula: sum(min(S_i/D_i,1)*D_i)/sum(D_i)

definition: Median uncapped supply-to-demand ratio across Monte Carlo draws
formula: median(S/D)

definition: Mean evidence confidence across modeled district cells
formula: mean(cell confidence score)

definition: Median modeled annual openings for the selected NCO groups
formula: median(opening rate × state demand × district allocation)
update_frequency: On each model refresh; demand source refresh as available

definition: Value of information score
formula: interval width × annual openings

definition: Composite evidence-collection priority
formula: VOI weighted by data/evidence quality signals

definition: Number of NCO cells blocked by the policy gate
formula: count(decision_status = NEEDS DATA)

definition: Number of modeled NCO cells with full actual evidence
formula: count(supply_coverage = full_actual)

definition: Distinct DGT ITIs represented in the provisional matrix
formula: count distinct ITI codes from DGT matrix

definition: Historical 2022 ITI count used only as an allocation weight
formula: source total
update_frequency: Historical snapshot; replace when current district totals arrive

definition: DGT matrix ITI coverage relative to the historical 2022 count
formula: DGT ITIs in matrix / 2022 ITI count

definition: District rank by uncapped median ratio
formula: rank descending on ratio_median

definition: Public policy gate status across the district's modeled NCO cells
formula: NEEDS DATA unless all cells share an actionable status
update_frequency: On each model refresh; policy gate remains NEEDS DATA until evidence is complete

definition: Maximum minus minimum district rank across the six scenarios
formula: max(rank) − min(rank)

definition: Number of the six scenarios in which a district is top five
formula: count(rank <= 5)

definition: Structural robustness flag
formula: top5_appearances = 6

definition: Observed institutional seat capacity used for public small-cell suppression
formula: sum(source seat rows)

definition: No selected DGT rows were observed for the analytical district
formula: supply_seats is missing before suppression

definition: Small-cell suppression flag
formula: supply_seats > 0 and supply_seats < 5

definition: Human-readable publication status
formula: derived from not_observed and suppressed flags
